lyrics:
[Intro: a doorbell note repeating, becoming a single piano note]

[Verse 1: breathy, close, piano only]
I signed the lease on Tuesday
Top floor, the one with the light
Like we said, with the window seat
And the kitchen painted white
I carried up the boxes
I counted every stair
I said "we're home" to no one
Out of habit, to the air

[Chorus: fuller voice, soft kick, pads]
And I got the keys
Two of them, on a ring
One's still warm from the cutting
It doesn't open anything
I walk from room to room
Saying "this is where you'd be"
I got the keys
Nobody told the keys

[Verse 2: breathy, a little bitter]
I guess you're in the suburbs
With someone who can park
Someone who likes the quiet
And is frightened of the dark
I hope the fence is perfect
I hope the lawn is green
I've got a view of rooftops
And a couch you've never seen

[Chorus: fuller voice, handclaps, pads]
And I got the keys
Two of them, on a ring
One's still warm from the cutting
It doesn't open anything
I walk from room to room
Saying "this is where you'd be"
I got the keys
Nobody told the keys

[Bridge: stacked voices building, drums crash in, belted]
Empty boxes, your handwriting
"Kitchen," "books" and "fragile things"
I keep hearing the buzzer ring
I keep running to let you in
And it's the wind, it's the wind, it's the wind

[Final Chorus: quiet again, piano and one voice]
I got the keys
Two of them, on a ring
I walk from room to room
I'm learning where I'll be
I got the keys

[Outro: doorbell note, a key turning, door closing softly]
